method: Eleventh lunch pass - San Jose value-lunch sweep (Alum Rock, Berryessa, Tully Rd, Santa Teresa, downtown, Murphy Ave, Aborn Square) plus West San Jose dim sum. Every field below was transcribed from a page actually retrieved this turn (URL in the row). Nothing was typed from memory. Prices that appear only in Reddit threads, Yelp Q&A answers or menu aggregators are described in the row and deliberately left out of the price column, per the standing project rule. Yelp business pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch here, so Yelp facts come from the Yelp business-page URL as surfaced by search and are levelled 'listing'/'conflicting', never 'official'.
